context: Extend the approved learning map into a SINGLE coherent app design, not three alternatives. Each draft is a working review board with two screen tabs, independent light/dark toggle, and Korean JLPT N3 / Japanese TOPIK3 toggle. Preview toolbar outside the product and clearly marked design demo; sample progress never real. Main product fits390px; responsive wider shell. Existing original logo must visibly use supplied Brand Asset URL on welcome and desktop shell; do not replace with emoji, initials or invented mark. Existing four-nav component is old styling: inline the NEW consistent four-column nav instead of inheriting old appearance. No API, authentication, audio, or save requests. All controls demonstrate only local state, and announce preview-only for unavailable actions. Keep everything from design-system.md including2026-10-14 extension.
